name: Deploy Nuvasto to Cloudflare
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['professional/**','worker/**','wrangler.jsonc','.github/workflows/deploy-cloudflare.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: {contents: read, deployments: write, statuses: write}
concurrency: {group: deploy-nuvasto-production, cancel-in-progress: true}
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with: {node-version: '22'}
      - name: Validate production candidate
        id: candidate
        working-directory: professional
        run: npm run verify
      - name: Confirm Cloudflare deployment credential
        id: credential
        shell: bash
        env: {CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: '${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}'}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" ]; then echo "::error::Falta CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"; exit 1; fi
      - name: Deploy Worker, assets, D1 and R2 bindings
        id: deploy
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: '${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}'
          accountId: f1adc1e73490ce30fe3c1588d2ca57fb
          workingDirectory: professional
          wranglerVersion: '4.114.0'
          command: deploy --config wrangler.toml --keep-vars
      - name: Verify deployed release, schema, storage and invoice arithmetic
        id: verify
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expected=$(node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('worker/src/combined.js','utf8');const m=s.match(/PLATFORM_RELEASE='([^']+)'/);if(!m)process.exit(1);process.stdout.write(m[1])")
          base='https://pedidos-pro-ai.botreservasmultilocal.workers.dev'
          for attempt in $(seq 1 24); do
            body=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 --dump-header /tmp/headers "$base/platform/health?release=$expected&attempt=$attempt" 2>/dev/null || true)
            release=$(grep -Ei '^x-nuvasto-release:|^x-pedidos-pro-release:' /tmp/headers 2>/dev/null | head -1 | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}' || true)
            ready=$(PLATFORM_HEALTH="$body" node <<'NODE'
          try {
            const h=JSON.parse(process.env.PLATFORM_HEALTH||'{}');
            const storage=h.ok===true&&h.r2Configured===true&&h.r2Required===true&&h.r2Ready===true&&h.storageBackend==='r2';
            const runtime=h.nativePerformanceV45===true&&h.schemaOffCriticalPathV45===true&&h.requestCoalescingV45===true&&h.operationsBootstrapV45===true&&h.directR2StreamingV45===true&&h.redirectSafeNavigationV50===true;
            const migration=h.folioMigrationV67===true&&Number(h.folioMigrationDetails?.skipped||0)===0;
            const legacy=h.ordersSchemaV67===true&&h.scopedHistoricalFoliosV67===true&&h.cursorOrdersV67===true&&h.reconciliationRequiredForClosure===true&&h.legacyDateFoliosRetired===true&&h.readOnlyOrderQueriesV68===true&&h.durableMasterDraftV69===true&&h.draftSaveNoFolioLockV69===true&&h.crossDeviceMasterDraftV70===true&&h.masterDraftServerBackedV70===true&&h.bulkClearMasterQuantitiesV70===true;
            const r71=h.domainRouterV71===true&&h.canonicalMasterOrderV71===true&&h.masterEditParityV71===true&&h.documentFolioNamesLockedV71===true&&h.deterministicInvoicePricingV71===true&&h.reducedPrecacheV71===true&&h.nativeScrollV71===true&&h.configurablePaymentMethods===true&&h.chequeSchedule===true&&h.invoiceChequeExtraction===true&&h.authTouchCoalescedV71===true;
            const r72=h.domainRouterV72===true&&h.passkeyAuthV72===true&&h.platformBiometricLoginV72===true&&h.optionalRememberDeviceV72===true&&h.legalTermsV2V72===true;
            const r73=h.domainRouterV73===true&&h.reconciliationAliasResolverV73===true&&h.reconciliationListV73===true&&h.financeRoutingV73===true&&h.orderPaymentRepairV73===true&&h.directDraftEditV73===true&&h.nativeMotionV73===true&&h.structuredInvoiceComparisonV73===true;
            const r74=h.domainRouterV74===true&&h.paymentDocumentsV74===true&&h.collectivePaymentAllocationV74===true&&h.sameSupplierPaymentV74===true&&h.multiInvoicePaymentV74===true&&h.multiOrderPaymentV74===true;
            const r76=h.supplierFinalUnitReadersV76===true&&h.printedFinalUnitPricingV76===true&&h.supplierInvoiceProfilesV76===true;
            const r77=h.paymentProofGeminiV77===true&&h.orderDetailPaymentsV77===true&&h.catalogFlowConsolidationV77===true;
            process.stdout.write(storage&&runtime&&legacy&&r71&&r72&&r73&&r74&&r76&&r77&&migration?'true':'false');
          } catch { process.stdout.write('false'); }
          NODE
            )
            if [ "$release" = "$expected" ] && [ "$ready" = "true" ]; then break; fi
            if [ "$attempt" = "24" ]; then echo "::error::Cloudflare no activó el release esperado. release=${release:-none} runtime=$ready body=$body"; exit 1; fi
            echo "Esperando despliegue ${attempt}/24 · release=${release:-none} · runtime=$ready"; sleep 10
          done
          stamp=$(date +%s)
          for asset in app.js app-bootstrap.js app-auth-experience.js app-session-bootstrap.js app-legal.js app-order-core.js app-router-v14.js app-master-order.js app-order-selection.js app-orders.js app-catalog.js app-documents.js app-payment-workflow.js app-order-detail-v30.js app-invoice-v30.js app-multi-invoice.js app-runtime-v30.js native-performance.css sw.js; do
            curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 20 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' "$base/$asset?v=$stamp" > "/tmp/$asset"
          done
          grep -Fq "CLIENT_RELEASE='$expected'" /tmp/app.js || { echo '::error::app.js productivo no coincide con el release'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq "import './app-session-bootstrap.js'" /tmp/app.js || { echo '::error::bootstrap de persistencia de sesión no está activo'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'nuvasto:ephemeral-token' /tmp/app-session-bootstrap.js || { echo '::error::sesión opcional no está en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'isUserVerifyingPlatformAuthenticatorAvailable' /tmp/app-auth-experience.js || { echo '::error::detección biométrica no está en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq '/api/auth/passkeys/login/options' /tmp/app-auth-experience.js || { echo '::error::login con passkey no está en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'Versión 2.0 · agosto de 2026' /tmp/app-legal.js || { echo '::error::términos actualizados no están en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq "from './app-order-core.js'" /tmp/app-bootstrap.js || { echo '::error::bootstrap no usa la entrada canónica de Lista Maestra'; exit 1; }
          if grep -Fq 'app-sso-v20.js' /tmp/app-bootstrap.js; then echo '::error::bootstrap todavía activa Cloudflare Access SSO'; exit 1; fi
          grep -Fq "import('./app-master-order.js')" /tmp/app-order-core.js || { echo '::error::Lista Maestra no se carga desde su propietario canónico'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'data-v32-order-primary' /tmp/app-order-core.js || { echo '::error::edición directa de borrador no está en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'LOCAL_DRAFT_VERSION=71' /tmp/app-master-order.js || { echo '::error::protección local de borrador r71 no está en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'SERVER_AUTOSAVE_DELAY=1200' /tmp/app-master-order.js || { echo '::error::sincronización de Lista Maestra no tiene la cadencia esperada'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'id="clearMasterQuantities"' /tmp/app-master-order.js || { echo '::error::botón Limpiar no está en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'data-v32-matrix-product' /tmp/app-catalog.js || { echo '::error::matriz multiproveedor no está operable'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'data-v32-image-key' /tmp/app-documents.js || { echo '::error::Documentos no expone vista previa de imágenes'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'openPaymentDocumentComposer' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::no existe compositor canónico de documento de pago'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'paymentProofFile' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::pagos no inicia por el comprobante'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq '/api/finance/payment-proof-analysis' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::pagos no usa análisis Gemini del comprobante'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'Gemini extrajo los verificadores' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::pagos no muestra verificadores extraídos por IA'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'id="v30Payment"' /tmp/app-order-detail-v30.js || { echo '::error::detalle de pedido no expone Registrar pago'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq "import('./app-payment-workflow.js')" /tmp/app-order-detail-v30.js || { echo '::error::detalle de pedido no abre el flujo canónico de pagos'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'openCollectivePayment' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::no existe pago colectivo'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq '/api/finance/payment-documents' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::frontend no usa documentos de pago'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq '/api/finance/payment-candidates' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::frontend no carga candidatos de pago'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'Solo este pedido' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::pago unitario por pedido no está disponible'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'Todo el proveedor' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::pago colectivo por proveedor no está disponible'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'openPaymentMethodsManager' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::no existe configuración de medios de pago'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'Cobros programados' /tmp/app-payment-workflow.js || { echo '::error::no existe panel de cobros programados'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'payment-collective' /tmp/app.js || { echo '::error::Más no expone pago colectivo'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'v30-reconcile-list' /tmp/app-invoice-v30.js || { echo '::error::cotejo no usa lista compacta'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'nuvasto_supplier_alias' /tmp/app-invoice-v30.js || { echo '::error::cotejo local no usa alias del proveedor'; exit 1; }
          if grep -Fq "upload.append('orderFile'" /tmp/app-invoice-v30.js; then echo '::error::factura sigue enviando PDF duplicado del pedido al motor'; exit 1; fi
          grep -Fq 'orderId:queue.orderId' /tmp/app-multi-invoice.js || { echo '::error::carga de factura perdió el pedido de origen'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'Precio final impreso · Total x Unidad' /tmp/app-multi-invoice.js || { echo '::error::revisión no expone el precio final unitario impreso'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'data-printed-final-unit' /tmp/app-multi-invoice.js || { echo '::error::revisión no preserva la columna Total x Unidad'; exit 1; }
          if grep -Fq "upload.append('orderFile'" /tmp/app-multi-invoice.js; then echo '::error::carga múltiple todavía duplica el PDF del pedido'; exit 1; fi
          grep -Fq 'v30-reconcile-row' /tmp/app-runtime-v30.js || { echo '::error::estilos de lista de cotejo no están en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'Medio de pago detectado por IA' /tmp/app-invoice-v30.js || { echo '::error::revisión de factura no presenta pago detectado por IA'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'Seleccionar todos' /tmp/app-order-selection.js || { echo '::error::Pedidos no tiene selección total'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'TRAZABILIDAD CERRADA' /tmp/app-orders.js || { echo '::error::Pedidos/Historial no están separados'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'mobileMoreIcon' /tmp/app.js || { echo '::error::Más no tiene iconografía canónica'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'Medios de pago' /tmp/app.js || { echo '::error::Más no expone configuración de medios de pago'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'mobile-more-grid' /tmp/native-performance.css || { echo '::error::Más no tiene layout ordenado'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'duration:140' /tmp/app-router-v14.js || { echo '::error::transición rápida de rutas no está en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'nuvasto-modal-enter' /tmp/native-performance.css || { echo '::error::transición de modal no está en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'overflow-y:auto' /tmp/native-performance.css || { echo '::error::contenido principal no tiene scroll nativo'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'nuvasto-v77-payment-proof-ops' /tmp/sw.js || { echo '::error::service worker no activó el corte de caché del motor de facturas'; exit 1; }
          if grep -Fq "'./app-procurement.js'" /tmp/sw.js; then echo '::error::Service Worker aún precarga bundles no críticos'; exit 1; fi
          grep -Fq 'apiNetworkTimeout' /tmp/sw.js || { echo '::error::timeout API adaptable no está en producción'; exit 1; }
          grep -Fq 'const cached=await cache.match' /tmp/sw.js || { echo '::error::assets de release no usan cache-first'; exit 1; }
          echo "Nuvasto $release · lectores de factura, pagos Gemini y catálogo/recorrido verificados en producción."
      - name: Production procurement journey
        id: synthetic
        if: steps.verify.outcome == 'success'
        working-directory: professional
        env:
          NUVASTO_BASE_URL: https://pedidos-pro-ai.botreservasmultilocal.workers.dev
          NUVASTO_E2E_EMAIL: '${{ secrets.NUVASTO_E2E_EMAIL }}'
          NUVASTO_E2E_PASSWORD: '${{ secrets.NUVASTO_E2E_PASSWORD }}'
        run: node tests/production-e2e-v44.mjs
      - name: Report authenticated E2E coverage
        id: e2e_coverage
        if: always() && steps.verify.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        env:
          E2E_EMAIL: '${{ secrets.NUVASTO_E2E_EMAIL }}'
          E2E_PASSWORD: '${{ secrets.NUVASTO_E2E_PASSWORD }}'
        run: |
          if [ -n "$E2E_EMAIL" ] && [ -n "$E2E_PASSWORD" ]; then echo 'authenticated=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo 'E2E autenticado configurado.'; else echo 'authenticated=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo '::warning::E2E autenticado no configurado; el smoke público sí fue ejecutado.'; fi
      - name: Publish production status on commit
        if: always() && !cancelled()
        shell: bash
        env: {GH_TOKEN: '${{ github.token }}'}
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.candidate.outcome }}" = "success" ] && [ "${{ steps.deploy.outcome }}" = "success" ] && [ "${{ steps.verify.outcome }}" = "success" ] && [ "${{ steps.synthetic.outcome }}" != "failure" ]; then
            state=success
            if [ "${{ steps.e2e_coverage.outputs.authenticated }}" = "true" ]; then description='Nuvasto publicado; factura/contexto y E2E autenticado OK'; else description='Nuvasto publicado; factura y contexto verificados'; fi
          else state=failure; description='El despliegue de Nuvasto no quedó verificado'; fi
          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/statuses/${GITHUB_SHA}" -f state="$state" -f context='nuvasto/production' -f description="$description" -f target_url="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
